card.law_is_about: Two Bundestag motions seeking a 15 euro minimum wage and changes to the adjustment process.
card.they_want: Reject statutory changes to the minimum-wage reference value and adjustment process.
card.they_claim: BT 21/346 is attributed to Die Linke and 21/347 to the Greens.
card.the_problem: The authorship is reversed: 21/346 is the Greens’ motion and 21/347 Die Linke’s.
